summary: Release terminal leases carrying the canonical repository identity

delivery.outcome: The terminal owner release accepts a lease bound to the canonical owner/name repository identity, so merged leases can be released after publication.
nonGoals: No change to review, approval or merge authority.
No weakening of owner, CAS, fencing, phase or ancestry checks.

architecture.decision: Reuse change_lease_check.canonical_owner_repository, already loaded as the canonical sibling, to accept the canonical owner/name identity in addition to the legacy local digest. Repository binding stays mandatory; a foreign identity still refuses.
architecture.rollback: Independently reviewed revert; preserve the ticket branch and adopted releases.

validation.evidence: A lease carrying the canonical owner/name releases through cancel then release.
A foreign repository identity still refuses; the legacy local digest keeps working.
Canonical governance gate passes on the ticket head.
